latest.title: otosora v0.5.0
latest.notes:
Otosora · 音空 0.5.0

New
- Stream home. The Stream page now opens on songs to jump back into, songs picked from what you heard last, your artists, artist mixes, albums and playlists, and genres to explore. It is built from your own listening, kept on the phone so it shows at once, and refreshes every few hours or when you pull down.
- Artist pages: a photo, a mix, popular songs, and albums. Album and playlist pages play, shuffle, or save the whole list to your Playlists.
- Visualizer: bars around the cover in now playing that move with the music. Turn it on in the now playing menu. Android lists it under microphone access; nothing is recorded.
- The song now playing is marked with moving bars in lists. Swipe the mini player sideways to change songs.

Faster streams
- Stream links are remembered on the phone until YouTube expires them, so songs you played before start without a new lookup, even after Otosora restarts.
- The top search result is looked up while you read the list, so it starts sooner when you tap it.
- When the connection drops in the middle of a song, Otosora picks up from the last byte instead of stopping.
- yt-dlp keeps its own cache, which makes repeat lookups quicker.

Fixes
- In-app update seemed stuck at "Downloading 100%". The file check now runs in the background and says "Checking the download…" and "Opening the installer…". If Android has not allowed Otosora to install apps, it opens that setting and says what to turn on. A "Download in browser" button is there as a fallback.

Pick the APK for your phone. Most phones today use **arm64-v8a**.
